name: software_delivery
description: Six bounded software-delivery briefs for offline benchmark comparison. Tasks are illustrative and do not claim production readiness.

tasks.title: URL Shortening API

brief.title: URL Shortening API
brief.description: Build a minimal URL shortening API that creates short codes for valid HTTP(S) URLs and resolves them on lookup. Keep scope small and safe for static evaluation.

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /links creates a short code for a valid URL.
GET /{code} resolves to the original URL.
Invalid URLs are rejected with a clear error.

implementation_constraints: Keep generated files small and safe.
Do not include secrets or live network calls.
tasks.notes: Baseline success scenario for mock harness validation.

tasks.title: Support Ticket Classification Service

brief.title: Support Ticket Classification Service
brief.description: Build a service that accepts support ticket text and returns a category label with a confidence score. Use explicit request and response data models.

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /classify returns a category for ticket text.
Request and response Pydantic models are defined.
Empty ticket text is rejected.
At least one unit test covers classification.

implementation_constraints: Do not call external ML APIs.

tasks.title: Document Ingestion API

brief.title: Document Ingestion API
brief.description: Build an API that accepts document metadata and returns a stored document identifier. Focus on validation and safe file layout.

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /documents stores metadata and returns an ID.
Missing or blank titles are rejected.
Generated files follow the permitted path prefixes.

implementation_constraints: Do not write outside permitted paths.
tasks.notes: Mock scenario exercises gate failure and repair success.

tasks.title: Feature Flag Service

brief.title: Feature Flag Service
brief.description: Build a minimal feature flag evaluation service with a GET endpoint that returns whether a named flag is enabled.

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /flags/{name} returns enabled state.
Unknown flag names return a safe default.
Unit tests cover enabled and unknown flags.

tasks.notes: Mock scenario exercises reviewer rejection and repair.

brief.title: Inventory Reservation Service
brief.description: Build a service that reserves inventory for a SKU and returns a reservation identifier. Include typed request/response models.

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /reservations creates a reservation for a SKU.
Reservation request and response models are defined.
Invalid SKU values are rejected.
Document that concurrency control is out of scope.

tasks.title: Incident Summary Service

brief.title: Incident Summary Service
brief.description: Build a service that accepts a list of incident events and returns a concise summary. Static policy gates should reject unsafe generated patterns such as shell execution helpers.

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /summaries returns a text summary for event lists.
Empty event lists are rejected.
Generated code must not invoke shell execution helpers.
Unit tests cover summary generation.

implementation_constraints: Do not use os.system, subprocess, eval, or exec.
tasks.notes: Mock scenario exercises provider failure; security gate relevant for live runs.
